description:
Set font family and size for active text layer.

Prefer the PostScript name (e.g. "ArialMT"): it is the same in every Photoshop UI language. A display name (e.g. "Arial") also works but can be localized; an exact PostScript match wins.
Use photoshop_list_fonts to discover available fonts.

document_id.description: Optional Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. When set, the tool activates that document before running so a UI tab switch cannot retarget the edit.

fontName.description: Font PostScript name (preferred, language-independent) or display name (see photoshop_list_fonts)

name: photoshop_set_text_font
